qualifier: ERK5, p38 and atypical MAPK6/4 branches
name: NGF-TRKA signalling to ERK5, p38 and atypical MAPKs
rationale: All members are TRKA/NGF-triggered kinase signalling to CREB and MAPKs, and the ERK5 cascade and MAPK6/MAPK4 members are what the NTRK3/NGF confusables lack.

name: TGF-beta/BMP SMAD signalling and extracellular ligand sequestration
rationale: Members regulate TGF-beta, BMP and NODAL SMAD signalling, and the extracellular sequestration/retention of ligands separates it from the SMAD2/3-transcription, left-right and endothelial confusables.

name: Cardiac conduction system development and myocyte depolarization
rationale: All members concern SA/AV node and His-Purkinje conduction, its development and depolarization phases, whereas confusables centre on repolarization and potassium channels.

qualifier: SRF contractile programme and vessel-wall modules
name: Vessel wall smooth muscle differentiation and SRF contractile programme
rationale: Members cover vascular smooth muscle development, SRF-driven cytoskeletal/contractile modules and perivascular/endothelial vessel-wall modules, lacking the phenotypic-switching and shear-stress terms of the confusables.

qualifier: plasma heme scavenging and non-transferrin iron import
name: Iron and heme uptake, including plasma heme scavenging
rationale: All members concern cellular acquisition and homeostasis of iron and heme, and the heme scavenging/transport and plasma-membrane iron import distinguish it from the transferrin-based confusables.

qualifier: with thyroid hormone and corticosteroid secretion
name: Steroid and thyroid hormone biosynthesis, secretion and response
rationale: Members span adrenal/gonadal steroidogenesis, corticosteroid secretion and thyroid hormone generation and signalling, whereas confusables are GH/prolactin/leptin signalling or vitamin/retinoid CYP metabolism.

name: IL-12 family and IL-10 cytokine signalling
rationale: All members are signalling by IL-12, IL-23, IL-27, IL-35 or IL-10, distinct from IL-20 family, IL-15/21 and cytokine-production confusables.

qualifier: with phospholipid and triglyceride synthesis regulation
name: Lipid droplet biogenesis and phospholipid synthesis regulation
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation/fusion and regulation of phospholipid and triglyceride synthesis in fat-storing cells, unlike the lipophagy and droplet-disassembly confusables.

qualifier: craniofacial, limb, ear and pharyngeal gland
name: Embryonic craniofacial, limb, ear and pharyngeal gland morphogenesis
rationale: All members are developmental morphogenesis of head, face, palate, ears, limbs and pharyngeal-derived glands, distinct from neural plate patterning and cardiac neural crest confusables.

name: AKT-FOXO and p53 regulation of glycolytic and metabolic genes
rationale: Members are AKT-mediated FOXO control, p53 and mTORC1 metabolic programmes and regulation of glycolysis/pentose-phosphate flux, unlike the NFE2L2 and fructose-bisphosphate confusables.

qualifier: pseudouridylation and methylation across rRNA, tRNA, mRNA
name: Pseudouridylation and methylation of rRNA, tRNA and mRNA
rationale: All members are pseudouridine synthesis or methylation of cytosolic RNAs, whereas confusables are tRNA aminoacylation, mitochondrial RNA processing or snoRNP assembly.

name: Adiponectin and insulin-sensitivity control of glucose uptake
rationale: Members regulate insulin responsiveness, glucose import and glycogen synthesis together with adiponectin signalling and secretion, which GLUT4-trafficking, IRS/AKT and glucagon confusables lack.

qualifier: mitotic nuclear envelope disassembly and ESCRT resealing
name: SUMOylation and mitotic nuclear envelope disassembly and resealing
rationale: Members are the SUMO conjugation cascade and its targets plus mitotic nuclear envelope breakdown, reformation and ESCRT-III sealing/abscission, unlike the nuclear pore, cohesin and spindle confusables.

qualifier: feeding, sleep, stress and social behaviour
name: Neuropeptide control of feeding, sleep, stress and social behaviour
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide/GPCR signalling with feeding, sleep-wake, HPA stress and mating/parental behaviour, unlike the growth-hormone and dopaminergic confusables.

name: Regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and peroxide-induced cell death
rationale: Members regulate electron transport/ATP synthesis and hydrogen peroxide- or iron-driven oxidative death including ferroptosis, distinct from ischemia, nitrosative stress and H2S confusables.

qualifier: proliferation and negative regulation of differentiation
name: Myeloid progenitor proliferation and restraint of myeloid differentiation
rationale: Members are the promyelocyte/progenitor programme, progenitor proliferation and negative regulation of granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation, unlike pro-differentiation, megakaryocyte and HSC confusables.

name: MITF-driven melanocyte pigmentation and differentiation programme
rationale: All members are MITF-M target programmes, melanin synthesis and melanocyte differentiation/pigment responses, distinct from keratinocyte and melanosome-biogenesis confusables.

name: Specialized pro-resolving mediator biosynthesis and eicosanoid catabolism
rationale: Members synthesise resolvins, protectins, maresins and lipoxins and catabolise leukotriene B4 and other eicosanoids, unlike leukotriene synthesis/receptor and hepoxilin confusables.

core: Organic acid and amino acid metabolism
name: General organic acid and amino acid metabolism
rationale: All members are broad (obsolete) umbrella terms for organic acid and alpha-amino acid metabolism, whereas each confusable concerns a specific amino acid.

name: Rett syndrome MECP2 loss-of-function variants
rationale: All three members are disease variants abolishing MECP2 methyl-DNA binding or phosphorylation, distinct from DNA methylation, activity-dependent transcription and behavioural confusables.

name: Arterial endothelial and coronary vascular development
rationale: Members cover arterial endothelial differentiation, vessel maturation, coronary vasculogenesis and cardiac vascular smooth muscle with BMP restraint, unlike venous, lymphatic, CNS and outflow-tract confusables.

name: Ryanodine receptor control of ER calcium release
rationale: Members regulate release and sequestration of ER/SR calcium via ryanodine-sensitive channels including skeletal muscle contraction, unlike store-operated entry and cardiac contraction confusables.

name: Urea cycle and arginine-citrulline-ornithine biosynthesis
rationale: All members are urea cycle metabolism of citrulline, ornithine and arginine and its transcriptional regulation, unlike the disease-variant, arginine catabolism and transport confusables.

name: Hedgehog autoprocessing and RAS C-terminal lipid processing
rationale: Members concern lipid modification and proteolytic processing of Hedgehog and RAS proteins, distinct from cysteine palmitoylation cycling and Wnt lipidation confusables.

qualifier: adrenergic Gi/z inhibition of adenylate cyclase
name: Adrenergic Gi/z inhibition of cAMP-PKA signalling
rationale: Members are cAMP synthesis, degradation and PKA activation with alpha-2 adrenergic and G alpha z inhibition of adenylate cyclase, unlike Gq-calcium, adenosine and dopamine-stimulatory confusables.
